meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 你要改 NanoClaw 时,它会先问清几个关键点(加什么渠道、接哪个助手、是否隔离),能用现成专用命令就用,否则直接改配置,再告诉你怎么重启与验证。
howto.when: 当你要求接入 Telegram、Slack 等新渠道、改动触发词,或做其他自定义更改时,它会接管处理。

say.text: 帮我加一个 Telegram 输入渠道,接到现有的助手。
say.note: 它会先弄清接到哪个助手、是否隔离,再执行。

say.text: 把 Slack 消息的触发词改成“问问助手”。
say.note: 它会更新对应会话的触发规则。

say.text: 给助手接入 Gmail 工具,让它能读邮件。
say.note: 它优先走 /add-gmail-tool 专用流程。

howto.what_en: When you ask to change NanoClaw, it first asks clarifying questions (which channel, which assistant, isolation), then prefers dedicated commands or edits config directly, and finally tells you how to rebuild, restart, and test.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a new channel (Telegram, Slack, etc.), change trigger phrases, or request any other customization for NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel for my existing assistant.
say_en.note: It will ask about isolation level first.

say_en.text: Change the Slack trigger phrase to “ask the assistant”.
say_en.note: It updates the wiring trigger rules.

say_en.text: Connect Gmail as a tool so my assistant can read email.
